scope: iOS SelectionArea default menu actions across required framework, companion, and native layers. Source inspection determines which layers already provide support.

checks.expectation: A nonempty iOS selection exposes Share, Look Up, and Search Web alongside existing applicable actions.
checks.evidence: Fixture selects a word in a real SelectableRegion and inspects its default items. Also verify public SelectionArea integration under consumer_wiring.

checks.expectation: Look Up, Search Web, and Share use the current selected substring, including after changing the selection.
checks.evidence: Fixture invokes real state-generated actions and captures SystemChannels.platform requests. Share may evolve to a structured payload for an anchor; inspect its matching native contract.

checks.expectation: Affected Material/Cupertino public components and customizable constructors expose and forward required actions.
checks.evidence: Inspect the submitted companion patch, audit affected callers, and run package tests that exercise rendered buttons and distinct forwarding paths. An untouched wrapper is valid if existing forwarding is proven sufficient.

checks.expectation: Required iOS/iPad actions are implemented through the native endpoint, including valid presentation anchoring where required for Share.
checks.evidence: Inspect platform channel handling and run relevant native tests. A successful mocked channel call alone is insufficient. If the environment prevents native verification, record it as unverified rather than claiming full success.

checks.expectation: Copy, Select All, action availability for empty/collapsed selections, and unaffected platform behavior remain correct.
checks.evidence: Run relevant existing framework/package suites and targeted platform availability tests; inspect any modified existing assertions.

checks.expectation: Tests demonstrate the original missing behavior and pass with the submitted change.
checks.evidence: Run an applicable behavioral test against unfixed source and fixed source. Compilation failures from newly introduced APIs do not establish reproduction.

checks.expectation: Required changes respect the applicable freeze and are complete, reviewable, and reproducible across repositories.
checks.evidence: Inspect diffs, apply exported companion patches to the pinned base, verify new files and pending changelogs, confirm no temporary absolute SDK overrides, and assess master/stable compatibility. Do not require publication of PRs.
